summary: Molecular sequences (GenBank) and a molecular-led synthetic tree (Open Tree of Life) exist for all classes, but the structural character matrices the claim needs sit in MorphoBank, which returned HTTP 403 to every scripted request. Matched morphology-plus-molecules matrices are open on Dryad but only for single groups (primates, mammals, one plant family), and none carries habit or ecology per taxon.
next_step: Get MorphoBank matrices by browser or contact the curators; pick two or three classes with a deposited morphology matrix and published molecular tree (primates 10.5061/dryad.4g42q is one); take habit classes from a separate trait table; pre-register tree-to-tree congruence (e.g. Robinson-Foulds) against an ecology-grouping null.
obstacles_confirmed: MorphoBank is not scriptable (HTTP 403 on both hosts).
Open matched morphology and molecular data found only for single clades, not across classes.
Circularity between character matrices and classification is not removable by data choice.
